==Biography==
Cristian Sebastian Quispe Yampara is from Arica, Chile.

=== 2016 Season===
His debut was in [[Eternals Gaming]] as a substitute Mid participating in minor tournaments, the march of that year leaves the team.

In March he joins [[Berserk e-Sports]] as Mid Laner participating in minor tournaments, in November of that year he leaves the team.

=== 2017 Season===
At the end of the year he joined [[Novus Tempus]] as Mid Laner participating in minor tournaments, leaving the team in November of that year.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[No Tenemos Nada]] as Mid Laner participating in the [[Circuito Nacional Argentina/2018 Season/Opening Season|2018 CNA Opening Season]] where the team was first in the tournament qualifying to the next phase. At the end of the tournament [[No Tenemos Nada]] is bought by [[Valorous]]. Already in the Playoffs the team was fourth in the tournament losing against [[Undead Gaming]] 2,0 , at the end of the tournament leaves the team.

In the middle of the year he joins [[Andes Esports]] as Mid Laner participating in [[Circuito Nacional Chile/2018 Season/Closing Season|2018 CNC Closing Season]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the Playoffs the team was third in the tournament losing against [[Universidad Católica Esports|UC Esports]] 2-3. At the end of the tournament he leaves the team.

=== 2019 Season===
At the beginning of the year he returns to [[Valorous]] as Mid Laner participating in the [[LHE 2019 Opening]] where the team was sixth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LHE 2019 Opening Playoffs]] the team was third in the tournament losing against [[Azules Esports]] 0-1, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team due to problems with the organization.

In the middle of the year he joins [[Azules Esports]] as Mid Laner participating in the [[LHE 2019 Closing]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LHE 2019 Closing Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Rebirth eSports]] winning 3-1, being for the first time champion, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[Regional Sur 2019]] the team reaches the final facing [[9z Team]] winning 3-1, qualifying to the next phase. Already in [[LLA 2020 Opening Promotion]] the team faces [[Kaos Latin Gamers]] winning 3-2, ascending to the LLA.

== Trivia ==
* Started to play the game by the end of Season 4.
* Reached Challenger Rank 1 in LAS server with just 15 years old.
* Was one of the best players in the [[Circuito Nacional Argentina/2018 Season/Opening Season|Circuito Nacional Argentina]]. Casters and fans loved him because of his skills.
** He also [http://clips.twitch.tv/PreciousBrainyPterodactylTooSpicy got a pentakill] with {{ci|Azir}} against [[Coscu Army]] in game 2 of the [[Circuito Nacional Argentina/2018 Season/Opening Season/Tournament 3|CNA Tournament 3]] finals.
* Reached Challenger Rank 1 in NA server at Season 10.
* Was nicknamed "La Farsa" by [[Absolut]] as a pun with [[Faker]]'s IGN in Spanish.<ref>[https://x.com/Absoluttlol/status/1883245934416625731 Absolut's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
